answer: A hostile operator running 155 aliases therefore needs 160 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in ridge, expire in signal, and sable lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 22 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
